description: 4-AO remote RTU I/O, Modbus RTU RS-485 9600 8N1. All AO registers are FC03 only (no FC01/FC02/FC04 AO space). FC03: AO_rawValue ch0-3 (1184-1187, 0-4095), AO_powerOnRawValue ch0-3 (1216-1219), AO_safeModeRawValue ch0-3 (1248-1251), AO_range ch0-3 (1280-1283, 0=0-10V 1=0-20mA).

| Moxa ioLogik R1241 Remote RTU I/O — 4-channel AO
| Source: ioLogik R1200 Series User Manual V3.2, November 2017 (Appendix)
| Protocol: Modbus RTU (RS-485); 9600 8N1 default, address configurable via software
| AO channels (ch0-3) — ALL registers are FC03; no FC01/FC02/FC04 for AO control:
| FC03 addr 0x04A0-0x04A3 (1184-1187): AO raw value ch0-3 (0 to 4095; R/W)
| FC03 addr 0x04C0-0x04C3 (1216-1219): AO power-on raw value ch0-3 (R/W)
| FC03 addr 0x04E0-0x04E3 (1248-1251): AO safe-mode raw value ch0-3 (R/W)
